finalProject.prompt: Explain how Jill Scott shaped neo-soul through poetic songwriting, emotional vulnerability, and jazz-influenced vocal performance. Compare ONE early track (‘A Long Walk’ or ‘He Loves Me’) with ONE later track (‘The Fact Is (I Need You)’ or ‘So In Love’). Identify TWO modern artists who clearly show Jill Scott’s influence.
